about_the_game:
A Relaxing Yet Challenging Parking Game – Simple Fun, No Stress!

Ever struggled with parallel parking? Now you can practice (and laugh at your silly mistakes) in this lighthearted, minimalist parking simulator! Navigate tight spots, tricky angles with different types of vehicles — from tiny hatchbacks, SUVs, and convertibles, to huge van — across 30+ levels in everyday settings like open carparks and city streets.

FEATURES

What This Demo Offers:

✅ 30-60 mins of Playtime – Master parking in open carparks and city streets!

✅ Simple but Addictive Gameplay – No complicated controls, just pure parking fun.

✅ 10 Unique Vehicles – Park a small hatchback, a long pickup truck, a mirrorless delivery van, police car, or an ambulance! Each handles differently.

✅ Multi-Camera Views – Switch between in-car (with working mirrors!) and top-down for the best angle.

✅ Score-Based Challenges – How straight is your parking? How much space did you leave? Aim for perfection!

✅ 3 Difficulty Modes – Play casually with Easy Mode or test your skills in Hard Mode!

⚠️ Potentially Some Bugs – I am a solo-developer, but I’ll keep improving!

What This Game DOES NOT Offer:

❌ Hardcore Realism – Physics, collisions, and sounds are simplified (no ultra-realistic sim here).

❌ Multiplayer/Open World – Focused on solo parking challenges.

❌ AAA Graphics – Proudly lighthearted & stylized

❌ High-Speed Thrills – No drifting, no 100km/h speeds (it’s a parking lot, after all).

❌ Traffic Systems – No AI cars or traffic lights — just you and the parking space.

Perfect for players who want:

  • A chill but engaging parking experience.

  • Lighthearted fun without hardcore simulation stress.

  • A game that doesn’t take itself too seriously!

🚀 Meet the Developer – Let’s Build This Together!

Hi there! I’m a solo indie dev (and a lifelong gamer who grew up on classics from the ’80s to 2000s). By day, I’m also a dad to two young boys — my brutal (and cutest) beta testers! 🎮

Now, I’m creating fun, enjoyable experiences full-time — like this parking challenge.

If you enjoy lighthearted, minimalist games made by fellow gamers, I’d be thrilled if you give it a try — and maybe even leave a review! Thanks for supporting indie devs like me. ❤️

As a one-person team, your feedback and advice are highly desired! Spot a bug? Have ideas? Let me know! Got a tricky parking spot from your hometown? 📸 Send me a pic — it might become a new level!

Wishlist now and join the journey — your involvement truly matters!
